target: forge.sh pr-create (github) — gh is pointed at the configured remote's repo (--repo), not whatever gh infers from origin
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/me/fork.git origin
fx_remote https://github.com/acme/widgets.git upstream
export FORGE_REMOTE=upstream
fx_gh pr_list 0 ''
fx_gh pr_create 0 'https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/9'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "lists=$(fx_count gh pr list)"; echo "creates=$(fx_count gh pr create)"
fx_calls_text
echo "list_acme=$(fx_calls_text | grep -E '^gh[[:space:]]+pr list' | grep -c 'acme/widgets')"
echo "create_acme=$(fx_calls_text | grep -E '^gh[[:space:]]+pr create' | grep -c 'acme/widgets')"
echo "fork_mentions=$(fx_calls_text | grep -c 'me/fork')"
fx_done
